warnings: op1 direct read (house 10). This sheet consolidates 7 small details onto one page — ST1/ST2 here are the SAME entry-step structures shown architecturally on A-14/A-15, just with structural rebar added.

'แบบขยาย 1' (jack-rafter-to-column steel flashing/fishplate connection) confirms the roof structure is genuinely mixed คสล.+steel (RC columns/beams, steel roof rafters bolted via embedded 50x300x6mm steel plate) — matching S-06's roof frame plan description.
